_about: Alexander F. Mitchell (1822-1899), professor of church history at St Andrews and the Assembly's 19th-century editor: The Westminster Assembly, its History and Standards (Baird Lecture, London: Nisbet, 1883) and Catechisms of the Second Reformation (London: Nisbet, 1886), which prints the Shorter Catechism's Puritan precursors and Rutherfurd's and other Scottish catechisms. Named alexander-mitchell so other Mitchells cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

mitchell-westminster-assembly-1883: The Westminster Assembly: its History and Standards (Baird Lecture for 1882; London, 1883)
mitchell-catechisms-second-reformation-1: Catechisms of the Second Reformation, with historical introduction and biographical notices (London, 1886)
